usage: Parses Jump List files, which record the files and destinations each application recently opened. Use it to see what documents a user opened and when, including from removable or network locations.
limitation: Only applications that use jump lists create them, and only after a user opened items. Old entries age out.

parameters.label: Jump list file
parameters.description: File to process. Either this or -d is required.

parameters.label: Directory
parameters.description: Directory to recursively process. Either this or -f is required.

parameters.label: All files
parameters.description: Process all files in directory vs. only *.automaticDestinations-ms or *.customDestinations-ms.

parameters.label: LNK details
parameters.description: Include more information about lnk files.

parameters.label: Full LNK details
parameters.description: Include full information about lnk files.

parameters.label: AppIDs file
parameters.description: Path to file containing AppIDs and descriptions (appid|description format).

parameters.label: Export LNK files to
parameters.description: Directory to save exported lnk files.

parameters.label: Show unaccounted entries
parameters.description: Show contents of Directory not accounted for in DestList entries.
